# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *

class EquityOptionAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        self._symbol = self.add_equity("SPY")
        self._option_chain_symbol = Symbol.create_canonical_option(self._symbol, "SPY")
        self._next_friday = (self.time + timedelta(4)).date()

        self.universe_settings.minimum_time_in_universe = timedelta(0)

        self.add_universe(self.universe.option_chain(self._option_chain_symbol))

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every(DayOfWeek.MONDAY),
            self.time_rules.at(9, 0),
            self._buildironcondor
        )
        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every(DayOfWeek.FRIDAY),
            self.time_rules.at(16, 30),
            self._closeironcondor
        )

    def _get_option_contract(self, option_chain: list[OptionContract], delta: float, tolerance: float = 0.0001) -> OptionContract | None:
        sorted_by_delta = sorted(option_chain, key=lambda x: x.delta)
        n = len(sorted_by_delta)
        target_delta = delta
        if n % 2 == 0:
            target_delta = (sorted_by_delta[n // 2 - 1].delta + sorted_by_delta[n // 2].delta) / 2
        for contract in sorted_by_delta:
            if abs(contract.delta - target_delta) < tolerance:
                return contract
        return None

    def _buildironcondor(self) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            return
        chain = self.option_chain(self._option_chain_symbol)
        if not chain:
            return
        expiry = min([x.expiry for x in chain])

        call_delta = -0.10
        put_delta = 0.10
        call_contract = self._get_option_contract([x for x in chain if x.right == OptionRight.CALL], call_delta)
        put_contract = self._get_option_contract([x for x in chain if x.right == OptionRight.PUT], put_delta)

        if not (call_contract and put_contract):
            return

        strike = (call_contract.strike + put_contract.strike) / 2
        wing_strike = sorted(set([x.strike for x in chain if x.expiry == expiry]))[0]
        inner_wing_strike = sorted(set([x.strike for x in chain if x.expiry == expiry]))[1]

        contracts = [
            OptionContract.create(wing_strike, expiry, OptionRight.CALL),
            OptionContract.create(wing_strike, expiry, OptionRight.PUT),
            OptionContract.create(inner_wing_strike, expiry, OptionRight.CALL),
            OptionContract.create(inner_wing_strike, expiry, OptionRight.PUT)
        ]
        for contract in contracts:
            self.add_option_contract(contract)

        iron_condor = OptionStrategies.iron_condor(self._symbol, call_contract, put_contract, inner_wing_strike, inner_wing_strike)
        self.buy(iron_condor, 1)

    def _closeironcondor(self) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            for contract in self.portfolio.get_active_option_contracts():
                self.liquidate(contract)
